newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH BYTOM PLANS PLN 15 MLN MUNICIPAL BONDS.
newsitem.headline: POLISH BYTOM PLANS PLN 15 MLN MUNICIPAL BONDS.

text.p: The southern Polish town of Bytom plans a private placement of 15 million zlotys worth of five- year municipal bonds by the end of June next year, the town's spokesman said on Tuesday.
"The 15-million-zloty municipal bond issue will be completed by June 1997," Janusz Bugiel told Reuters, adding that 1,500 bonds would be issued.
Bugiel said the issue would be placed with 300 firms and that the proceeds would go toward the renovation of the town's central square and the building of a centre for the promotion of the town.
He said the square renovation might help draw investors to central Bytom.
